mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in implementing AI SEO for a restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing AI SEO for a restoration company generally involves several key steps. First, AI tools analyze your current website, local search landscape, and competitor strategies. Next, a data-driven keyword strategy is developed, focusing on emergency and local search terms. Content optimization, including website text and blog posts, follows. Technical SEO audits are performed, and Google My Business profiles are optimized. Ongoing monitoring, reporting, and adjustments based on AI-generated insights ensure continuous improvement and adaptation to search algorithm changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include AI analysis of websites and competitors, data-driven keyword strategy, content optimization, technical SEO, Google My Business optimization, and continuous monitoring and adjustments.
